ali.body:
# Daily stand-up — Sunday 22 Nov 2026

**Chair:** Ali (CEO) · **Present:** Ram, Ahmed, Saif, Hisham, Aiman

## Round the table

| Who | Done | Status |
|---|---|---|
| Hisham | Searched GitHub, read 5 skill libraries, recommends 3 skills (8D Guru, Excel Hygiene, HR Recruiting) | ✅ done |
| Ahmed | Audited the Equipment Library: 10 machines, all complete; 5 of 7 areas empty | ✅ done |
| Ram | Routine ready; needs production plan, actual output, downtime log | ⏳ waiting for data |
| Aiman | Routine ready; needs incident log, open actions, permit register | ⏳ waiting for data |
| Saif | Routine ready; needs job descriptions, CVs, attendance, visa/contract list | ⏳ waiting for data |

## Decisions for Ahmed (yes / no)

1. **Connect Microsoft 365** (Outlook, OneDrive, SharePoint, Teams: read-only search) so the team reads its own files
   and mail instead of waiting for uploads?
2. **Install Hisham's three skills** (8D Guru, Excel Hygiene, HR Recruiting) into the project?
3. **Run the team automatically** every working day (Sun–Thu, 07:40 Muscat): each agent does its routine, I write these
   minutes, the office and dashboard are updated?
4. **Casting next** for the Equipment Library (Ahmed's proposal)?

## Actions

| # | Action | Owner | Due |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Send production plan, actual output and downtime log | Ahmed (human) → Ram | 24 Nov |
| 2 | Send incident / near-miss log and permit register | Ahmed (human) → Aiman | 24 Nov |
| 3 | Send HR files (JDs, CVs, attendance, expiry list) | Ahmed (human) → Saif | 24 Nov |
| 4 | Send scrap, downtime and energy data (3 months) | Ahmed (human) → Ahmed | 24 Nov |
| 5 | Install approved skills; outline a plant-safety skill | Hisham | after decision 2 |
| 6 | Send the Casting machine manuals | Ahmed (human) | 30 Nov |

**Rule reminded:** nobody sends anything outside the team. Letters, emails and purchase requests are drafts for a human.

ahmed.body:
# Equipment Library status — 22 Nov 2026

## Coverage by area (metal-flow order)

| # | Area | Machines | Complete* |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Melting | 9 | 9 |
| 2 | Casting | 0 | – |
| 3 | Die Maintenance | 0 | – |
| 4 | Heat Treatment | 0 | – |
| 5 | CNC | 1 (2 t EOT crane) | 1 |
| 6 | Paint Line | 0 | – |
| 7 | Packing | 0 | – |
| | **Total** | **10** | **10** |

\*Complete = 3D simulator, 20 s tour video, poster and the source manuals are all in the package (checked file by file).

Melting machines: HA01 furnace, HC01 furnace, degassing machine, dust collector, SWM#1 sidewell melter, vibratory feeder,
spare-parts catalogue, ingot casting machine, launder transfer pump. All were added 18–19 Nov.

## Findings

1. **The library covers only the start of the metal flow.** Casting is the next area and the one where most scrap is
   made, so it gives the most training value next.
2. **The EOT crane sits under CNC.** Confirm that is where it works; if it serves several areas we keep it there and
   mention the areas on its card.
3. Each package lists its assumed values ([A]) in its README. Nothing is blocking, but each [A] should be confirmed by
   the area engineer when the package is used for training.

## Improvement action proposed

**Fill the Casting area next.** Send the manuals for the casting machines (LPDC / die casting cells, cooling, X-ray).
Target: Casting complete within two weeks.

## KPI summary

No KPI data received yet. To start the KPI dashboard I need, in `inbox/ahmed/` (Excel is fine):
scrap by part and defect, downtime by machine, and energy per kg, for the last 3 months.

**Done today:** library audit. **Planned tomorrow:** start the KPI summary as soon as the files arrive.
**Blockers:** KPI files; Casting manuals.

hisham.body:
# New skills for the team — week 1

**How I searched:** GitHub repository search (10 queries: manufacturing, lean six sigma, Excel, safety, HR, maintenance,
8D quality, meeting minutes, KPI dashboards, the official Anthropic library). I downloaded the five most relevant
libraries and read each `SKILL.md`, its licence and the files that run code. Nothing was installed.

## Recommended (3)

| Skill | For | Why | Licence | Checked |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **8D Guru** (`jilanfang/8d-guru`) | Ahmed, Ram | Coaches a full 8D investigation (D0–D8) with root-cause challenges and scoring; has an ISO 9001 and an IATF 16949 add-on. Fits customer complaints on castings. | MIT | Pure markdown (244 lines), no scripts run. Safe. |
| **Excel Hygiene** (`BayramAnnakov/excel-hygiene`) | Ram, Ahmed, Ali | Checks any spreadsheet before it goes out: numbers stored as text, typed-over formulas, `#REF!` errors, cut-short SUM ranges. Useful for the production plan and the KPI sheets. | Apache-2.0 | One Python script (openpyxl) that only reads the file. Safe. |
| **HR Recruiting** (`tuanductran/hr-skills`, `hr-recruiting`) | Saif | Job descriptions, interview questions, CV screening, offer and rejection letters. The same library has onboarding and job-analysis skills. | MIT | Markdown only for the skill itself. Safe. |

## Already available to us (no install needed)

The official Anthropic skills for **Excel (xlsx), Word (docx), PDF and PowerPoint** are already enabled on our account.
Everyone can use them today: Ram for plan vs actual sheets, Saif for letters, Aiman for permit forms (PDF).

## Looked at, not recommended

- **Quality engineering skills** (`Siddardth7/quality-engineering-skills`: FMEA, SPC, MSA, 5-Why, fishbone, PPAP): good
  content, but every skill needs a separate "quality-mcp" server to do its calculations, and the repository has no
  licence. Use as reading material only.
- **Safety:** every "safety incident" skill found is about software incidents, not plant safety. **Gap:** I propose
  to write our own plant-safety skill for Aiman (incident log → 5-Why → corrective action → overdue list) once Aiman's
  first incident log arrives.
- **Meeting minutes:** the ones found transcribe Chinese audio; we do not need them, Ali writes minutes from our reports.

## Decision needed (Ahmed)

Install the three recommended skills into this project? **Yes / No.** Installing means copying their folders into
`.claude/skills/`; nothing runs until someone uses them.

## Skill of the day (11:00)

**8D investigations with 8D Guru**: walk through one real casting complaint from D0 to D8.

## IT status

No IT data received yet. Send the asset list (PCs, licences) and any open IT issues to `inbox/hisham/`.

**Done today:** skill search and review. **Planned tomorrow:** install approved skills; draft the plant-safety skill outline.
**Blockers:** approval to install; no IT data yet.
